capability: Define and reproduce the first prediction problem and baseline model behavior.

assumptions: Training examples represent the intended use population
A line is a useful first baseline
trust_boundaries: Test examples remain separate from parameter fitting

acceptance_criteria: Normal and failed runs reproduce from recorded controls.
Training and test evidence are reported separately.
Parameters and experiment controls are distinguished.
failure_behavior: Unstable updates produce an explicit warning and recovery action.
Curved evidence is identified as a capacity limitation.

decision.rationale: This reference contract is accepted only after the learner supplies reproducible evidence.
open_questions: Which additional feature will later improve the baseline?
